provenance.method: Expanded author-labelled questions: 60 card decision questions mapped to exact owner sections and 40 out-of-scope/vendor-specific questions with no accepted page. Search output was not used as acceptance evidence.
provenance.review_note: No independent adjudication; keep author-labelled until a separate reviewer adjudicates the additions.

items.question: Registered users are numerous, but the service sees only a modest request rate. What must a capacity estimate include besides user count?

Explains operation mix, bursts and hot keys hidden by an aggregate demand estimate.

items.question: A team says the system must be both fast and durable. How should that preference become a testable quality requirement?
